instructions: Complete the sentences below. Choose NO MORE THAN TWO WORDS from the passage for each answer.

items.prompt: Four fifths of the trees the volunteers stood among were Norway spruce, the remaining fifth being ........ .
items.evidence: In the forest condition, participants walked for five minutes to reach a stand of Norway spruce and silver birch trees, roughly 80 and 20 per cent of the stand respectively, ranging in age from 80 to 108 years and fully covered in snow, where they spent 15 minutes simply standing or sitting quietly.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says the stand is roughly 80 per cent spruce and 20 per cent birch; since the question asks for the species making up the remaining fifth, the answer is 'silver birch'.

items.prompt: Reaching the campus viewpoint took the volunteers only ........ , against the five-minute walk out to the trees.
items.evidence: In the comparison condition, participants instead walked two minutes to a spot on campus where they spent 15 minutes viewing nearby buildings, an environment the researchers deliberately chose to be calm and free of traffic rather than obviously stressful.
items.explanation: Paragraph C says participants walked two minutes to the campus spot, against the five-minute walk to the forest stand; so the answer is 'two minutes'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The air on the days of the outdoor sessions was almost windless and extremely damp, with ........ measured at 94.25 per cent.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The forest sessions took place in late January, in conditions typical of a Finnish winter: an average temperature of minus 7.23 degrees Celsius, 20 to 25 centimetres of snow covering the ground and trees, humidity of 94.25 per cent, and only a light wind of 1.13 metres per second.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bosluk yuzde olarak verilen bir hava olcumunu istiyor; pasajin siraladigi dort degerden (sicaklik, kar derinligi, nem, ruzgar) yalniz biri yuzdeyle ifade edilir, dolayisiyla sayinin birimi tek basina cevabi veriyor. Birimi gizlemek sayiyi da gizlemeyi gerektiriyor, o zaman da soru olculebilir bir ayrintiya dayanmaktan cikiyor. E6 bu yuvayi ruzgar hizina (1.13 m/s) ya da kar derinligine capalamali.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru D/1'e capaliydi; bosluk yuzde olarak verilen bir hava olcumunu istiyordu ve pasajin dort degerinden yalnizca biri yuzdeyle ifade edildigi icin birimin kendisi cevabi veriyordu. Yeni soru D/1'e hic degmiyor: kanit C/2'ye, karsilastirma kosuluna yurume suresine tasindi. Sure keyfi bir tasarim ayrintisi; birim ipucu tasimiyor cunku iki sure de dakika cinsinden ve biri cercevede veriliyor.

items.prompt: Of the six negative mood states the study tracked, ........ fell significantly after the visit to the forest.
items.evidence: After the forest exposure, five of the six negative mood states measured by the Profile of Mood States, tension-anxiety, anger-hostility, depression-dejection, fatigue and confusion, all decreased significantly.
items.explanation: Paragraph F says that after the forest exposure five of the six negative mood states decreased significantly; so the answer is 'five'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: The Profile of Mood States, a ........ scale, covered six mood dimensions, among them fatigue and vigour.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The Profile of Mood States, a 65-item scale, measured six mood dimensions including tension, anger, depression, fatigue, confusion and vigour.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Bosluk olcegin madde sayisini hedefliyordu ve Profile of Mood States'in 65 maddelik olmasi pasajin sectigi bir deger degil, olcegin gercek dunyadaki kunyesi. E7 parcasiz olcumunde uc turun ucunde de dogru bilindi; dayanak general_knowledge. Ayni sorun ayni paragraftaki oteki olcek adlari icin de gecerliydi (PANAS 20 madde), dolayisiyla yuvanin E paragrafinda kalmasi mumkun degildi.
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Kanit ayni pasajin F/1 cumlesine tasindi ve hedef, olcegin kunyesi yerine calismanin kendi olctugu sayiya cevrildi: alti olumsuz duygu durumundan kaci ormandan sonra anlamli bicimde dustu. Bu oran ne olcegin adindan ne de alan bilgisinden cikarilabiliyor; yalniz F/1 veriyor. Ayrica E paragrafinin yuku dortten uce indi ve olcek adi soruda hic gecmedigi icin matching-features kalemlerine ipucu sizmiyor.

items.prompt: The 22 students who volunteered, half of them women, had an average age of ........ .
items.evidence: To investigate, researchers recruited 22 healthy university students, 11 women and 11 men, with an average age of 22.5, from a university of applied sciences in southern Finland.
items.explanation: Paragraph B says the 22 students recruited, 11 women and 11 men, had an average age of 22.5; so the answer is '22.5'.

yeniden_uretim.eski_prompt: One explanation put forward for the absence of any rise in vigour is that a thick white layer conceals the green ........ which earlier work has tied to sharper alertness.
yeniden_uretim.eski_kanit_cumlesi: The researchers suggest that snow itself may partly explain why vigour failed to rise after the forest visit, since a thick covering of snow hides the green vegetation that other studies have linked to increased energy and alertness, leaving only the calming, restorative effect intact rather than the more energising one.
yeniden_uretim.neden_elendi: Model parcasiz uc turun ikisinde birebir 'vegetation', birinde tam es anlamlisi 'foliage' verdi -- yani sizinti kelime duzeyinde bile neredeyse tam. Boslugun hedefi 'karin ortudugu yesillik' ve bunun Ingilizcede birden cok es adi var (vegetation / greenery / foliage / plant life). Kanit cumlesi (H/1) canliligin neden yukselmedigini yalniz bu tek nedenle acikliyor, dolayisiyla her cerceve 'kalin kar neyi gizler' sorusuna donuyor ve cevabi kendisi veriyor. E6 onerisi: ayni cumlenin son yarisi -- yalniz sakinlestirici etkinin ayakta kalmasi, canlandirici etkinin kalmamasi -- ya da H/2'deki orneklem sinirlari (tek kurum, kucuk orneklem, onerilen uc genisletme).
yeniden_uretim.ne_degisti: Eski soru H/1'e capaliydi; model parcasiz uc turun ikisinde birebir 'vegetation', birinde tam es anlamlisi 'foliage' verdi, cunku 'kalin kar neyi gizler' sorusunun Ingilizcede birden cok es adi var. Yeni soru H paragrafina hic degmiyor: kanit B/1'e, orneklemin ortalama yasina tasindi. Ondalikli ortalama disaridan turetilemez ve es anlamli bir karsiligi yok.
